{{Quote|I am Master Ni-Cada. And this is Padawan Lo Bukk.|Ni-Cada talking to Plagueis|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
'''Ni-Cada''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], he and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Lo Bukk]], were dispatched by the Order to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abraxin]] to investigate the continued slaughter of [[Marsh haunt]]s, which were perpetrated by the Force-sensitive [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Naat Lare]]. On the planet, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] unknowingly crossed paths with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] who was also seeking Lare. Plagueis managed to make contact with Lare and manipulate him into attacking Ni-Cada and his Padawan as proof of Lare's worthiness to join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. After a short [[Duel on Abraxin|skirmish]], Lare was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Ni-Cada.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master?" <br /> "It's done. He's dead.|Lo Bukk and Ni-Cada, after Ni Cada kills Naat Lare|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Ni-Cada served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[67 BBY/Legends|forty-five]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Lo Bukk]], a male [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], were dispatched by the Order to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abraxin]], a swampy world in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], to investigate the continued slaughter of the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Marsh haunt]]s,<ref name="Darth P" /> swamp-dwelling gray and green skinned creatures.<ref name="TCSE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The Marsh haunt [[Death/Legends|killings]] were perpetrated by the Force-sensitive male [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Naat Lare]]. Lare had been selected by [[Darth Venamis]], a prospective [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the lineage of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], as a potential [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].<ref name="Darth P" />

During their stay on the swamp world, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were bargaining with a [[Unidentified Barabel (Abraxin)|member]] of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]]<ref name="Darth P" /> [[Species/Legends|species]], who were cold-blooded reptilians from the planet [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]],<ref name="TCSE" /> for a [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] when the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] Sith Lord [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] passed by under disguise. Both Ni-Cada and Lo Bukk [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] Plagueis' presence, though neither of them identified him as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], a sect of Force-sensitives who utilized the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. After, the Jedi unknowingly crossed paths again with Darth Plagueis while bearing flagons of liquid from an [[Unidentified eatery (Abraxin)|eatery]], as they sat at a table and talked to the Muun about the recent events of Marsh haunt slaughtering. Although it was unknown to Ni-Cada and his Padawan, the Muun was also secretly seeking Lare. Plagueis later managed to make contact with Lare and manipulate him into attacking Ni-Cada and his Padawan as proof of Lare's worthiness to become a Sith. Ni-Cada killed Lare after a short [[Duel on Abraxin|skirmish]] fought near the water, where the Jedi tracked Lare to with the skimmer.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This so-called Blight will be over by tomorrow.|Ni-Cada, on the killing of the Marsh haunts|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
Ni-Cada had a more reserved attitude, as he withheld the reason of his visit to Abraxin from Plagueis, though Lo Bukk told the Muun anyway. Ni-Cada was tall and rangy. When the Muun Sith Lord Darth Plagueis passed by under disguise, both Ni-Cada and Lo Bukk felt Plagueis' presence, though neither of them identified him as a Sith, a sect of Force-sensitives who utilized the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ni-Cada first and currently only appearance to date was in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]]. The novel tells the backstory of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Darth Plagueis.
